sections.title: About the Role
blocks: At House of Marketers, we help global brands grow through **high-performing influencer marketing campaigns** across multiple markets and platforms. As we continue to scale, our **pod-based structure** keeps account ownership, delivery, and commercial growth close together — and this role is one of its four core seats.

The Account Manager **owns the day-to-day relationship for a portfolio of existing client accounts** and keeps their campaigns moving. Sitting between the client and the pod’s delivery team, you are **the client’s trusted daily partner**.

You drive **retention, renewals, and upsell** within your portfolio, brief the Campaign Managers on what your accounts need, and flag risk early to the Account Director. You own the relationship and the account — within the frame the Account Director sets for the pod.

list: Own the day-to-day relationship, communication, and satisfaction for a portfolio of accounts
Be the client’s trusted daily point of contact following handover from the sales process
Lead routine client calls, campaign reviews, and performance conversations for your accounts
Own retention and renewals across your own accounts
Identify and drive upsell and expansion opportunities within your portfolio
Keep your accounts engaged, satisfied, and seeing value
Brief and direct the Campaign Managers on the priorities of your accounts, within the Account Director’s frame
Keep campaigns on track — deadlines met, communication proactive and clear
Identify account and delivery risk early and propose solutions; escalate to the Account Director when it exceeds your accounts
Maintain accurate CRM records and account reporting across your portfolio
Keep the Account Director informed on account health, risk, and opportunity

sections.title: Where the Role Sits
blocks: The Account Manager sits in **one pod**:

list: **Reports to: Account Director**
**Manages: no direct reports**
**Directs (dotted line): the pod’s Campaign Managers**, on the priorities of your own accounts

blocks: **You own the relationship and the account, within the frame the Account Director sets.**

sections.title: What the Role Does Not Own

list: Pod-wide prioritisation and arbitration when accounts compete for capacity — owned by the Account Director
Managing people — Account Managers are managed by the Account Director; Campaign Managers by Delivery (Head of Delivery & Performance)
Campaign execution and delivery admin — owned by the Campaign Managers
Net-new business — owned by the Director of Partnerships (Pod Lead)

items.title: Be proactive
blocks:
If something looks wrong, **investigate it before somebody asks you to.**

Do not wait for a problem to become an escalation.

items.title: Be intelligently curious
blocks:
Before asking someone else for the answer, **check.**

Look at the data. Speak to the right people. Test your assumptions. Understand what is actually happening.

Then **bring a recommendation, not just a question.**

items.title: Take ownership
blocks:
We do not want problems passed from person to person or department to department.

If you own something, **you stay close to it until there is a solution.**

items.title: Think from first principles
blocks:
If the same problem keeps happening, we do not want another checklist or temporary fix.

Understand why it is happening and **fix the root cause.**

items.title: Move fast
blocks:
Our industry changes constantly. Technology changes constantly. The company changes quickly.

You should be comfortable **testing new ideas, trying new tools, changing direction**, and **making decisions without waiting for perfect information.**

items.title: Use AI with judgement
blocks:
We use AI heavily, but **we do not want AI slop.**

AI should help you **think, analyse, automate, and move faster.** It should not result in endless generic documents, unnecessary documents, or reports nobody needs.

**Clear thinking comes first.**

list: Minimum 2 years in account management, client services, sales, partnerships, or a similar commercially-focused role
Fluent English, with strong communication and client-facing skills
Able to manage multiple clients, priorities, and projects in a fast-paced environment
Commercial mindset — confident identifying growth opportunities and building long-term relationships
Experience in influencer, digital, social, or agency environments is a strong advantage
AI fluency and operational system knowledge/comfort

sections.title: What Success Looks Like
blocks: You are doing this role well when:

list: Retention and renewals are strong across your portfolio
Upsell and expansion revenue grows within your accounts
Clients on your accounts are satisfied
Issues are flagged early, before they escalate
CRM records and account reporting are accurate and up to date
